day_of_month.description: The day of the month of each occurrence; the 29th to the 31st are the last day of a shorter month (FR-AR-07).

ends_on.description: No occurrence after this date; leave it out for no end.

every_months.description: Every 1, 3, 6 or 12 months: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly.

starts_on.description: The first occurrence is the first on or after this date, in the months from this one; one in the past is made by the next run.
